name: choco
title: Chocolatey
description: Search, install, upgrade, pin, and uninstall Chocolatey packages on Windows, manage sources, and export package manifests.
author: user_fb2826b29bbab02dfe18

preferences.name: chocoPath
preferences.title: Chocolatey Executable Path
preferences.description: Custom path to choco.exe. Leave empty to auto-detect via ChocolateyInstall or PATH.

preferences.name: elevationMethod
preferences.title: Elevation Method
preferences.description: How administrative Chocolatey commands (install, upgrade, uninstall, pin, sources) are executed.

preferences.name: confirmAutomatically
preferences.label: Confirm prompts automatically (-y)
preferences.description: Pass -y to install, upgrade, and uninstall commands so they run without interactive prompts.

preferences.name: useCommunityApi
preferences.label: Use Chocolatey Community OData API for search
preferences.description: Fetch rich package metadata, icons, and download counts quickly from community.chocolatey.org. Disable to query local/private sources via choco search.

preferences.name: includePrerelease
preferences.label: Include prerelease packages
preferences.description: Include prerelease package versions in search results.

preferences.name: showPackageIcons
preferences.label: Show package icons
preferences.description: Display package icons from Chocolatey repository metadata.

commands.name: search
commands.title: Search Packages
commands.description: Search Chocolatey packages and install them

commands.name: installed
commands.title: Show Installed
commands.description: List installed and pinned Chocolatey packages

commands.name: upgrades
commands.title: Show Upgrades
commands.description: Review outdated Chocolatey packages and upgrade them

commands.name: sources
commands.title: Manage Sources
commands.description: Add, enable, disable, and remove Chocolatey package sources

commands.name: export
commands.title: Export Packages
commands.description: Export installed Chocolatey packages to packages.config XML
